description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
 
Enterprise Provider Healthcare Sales Leader (Central U.S.)

Why We Have This Role

The Enterprise Provider Healthcare Sales Leader will define and execute the growth strategy for one of Qualtrics’ most important and strategic verticals. Following Qualtrics’ acquisition of Press Ganey, this executive will lead the newly combined Central Market organization (Florida, Georgia, Tennessee, Ohio, Illinois, and Minnesota), bringing together client-facing teams, aligning go-to-market motions, and expanding our impact across the nation’s largest health systems, academic medical centers (AMCs), and integrated delivery networks (IDNs). Serving as the senior commercial leader for the Central U.S. Provider business, you will engage directly with health system CEOs, COOs, CMOs, CNOs, CHROs, Chief Experience Officers, and other senior stakeholders to connect experience, safety, and workforce insights to clinical, operational, and financial outcomes. You will partner closely with Product, Customer Success, Solution Engineering, Marketing, and Executive Leadership to shape market strategy, influence product innovation, and oversee a high-performing organization of frontline sales leaders and Enterprise Account Executives.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Sales Complexity: Proven mastery of complex, enterprise-wide SaaS sales cycles involving multi-buyer consensus (C-suite, clinical, IT, HR) across large healthcare networks.
  • Ecosystem Expertise: Demonstrated ability to build, negotiate, and leverage partner ecosystem relationships to expand channel reach and co-sell enterprise deals.
  • Growth at Scale: History of leading enterprise sales teams through rapid scaling ($1B to $5B+ corporate trajectories), driving both strategic new-logo acquisition and land-and-expand account growth.
  • Operational Rigor: Exceptional operational discipline leveraging sales analytics, key performance indicators, and structured inspection mechanisms to drive reliable pipeline generation and accurate forecasting.
  • Leadership from the Front: Hands-on executive leader who engages directly in complex sales cycles, coaches teams through high-stakes negotiations, and acts as a force multiplier in key deals.
  • US Healthcare Domain Authority: Deep understanding of the Healthcare Provider ecosystem, as well as the regulatory environment and key executive stakeholders that influence purchasing decisions and strategic partnerships.

How You’ll Grow

  • Shape market strategy and influence product innovation by bringing customer insights directly into the evolution of the Qualtrics Experience Management platform and Press Ganey solutions, including emerging AI capabilities.
  • Lead a uniquely transformative post-acquisition integration, uniting Qualtrics and Press Ganey client-facing teams to strengthen our position as the market leader in healthcare experience management.

Things You’ll Do

  • Drive Revenue Growth & Business Expansion: Own and exceed annual revenue goals across net-new ACV, expansion revenue, and renewals by executing strategies that deepen customer adoption, increase platform utilization, and position Qualtrics as the leading Experience Management partner.
  • Execute Strategic Market Leadership: Develop and execute a comprehensive go-to-market strategy for the Central U.S. Enterprise Provider segment, identifying, prioritizing, and penetrating high-value accounts to drive sustainable growth and increased market share.
  • Lead Executive Selling & Complex Enterprise Execution: Lead a multi-product enterprise sales motion across complex buying centers, navigating sophisticated procurement environments and building strong C-suite relationships that demonstrate measurable business impact.
  • Accelerate Ecosystem & Partner Development: Build and strengthen strategic partnerships across healthcare consulting firms, systems integrators, technology providers, and industry influencers through joint go-to-market initiatives that accelerate pipeline generation and increase win rates.
  • Drive Operational Excellence & Forecast Accuracy: Establish a disciplined operating rhythm built on data-driven decision-making, forecast accuracy, and pipeline health, partnering closely with Sales Operations to optimize territory planning, resource allocation, and sales productivity.
  • Champion People Leadership & Talent Development: Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing sales leaders and Enterprise Account Executives by fostering a culture of accountability, coaching, inclusion, and continuous improvement that drives consistent quota attainment.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • Enterprise SaaS sales experience, with significant tenure dedicated to leading enterprise sales teams ideally selling directly into the US Enterprise Healthcare Provider market.
  • 2+ years of second-line executive sales leadership experience managing multi-layered teams (sales managers and enterprise account executives) preferred.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding complex vertical revenue targets within rapidly scaling organizations ($1B to $5B+).
  • Expertise in direct selling methods as well as building and co-selling alongside strategic partner networks.
  • Proven operational success in leading multi-product, enterprise software motions with long, complex decision-making cycles.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.

What You Should Know About This Team

  • Unprecedented Market Impact: You will lead the newly combined Central Market organization following the Press Ganey acquisition, giving you the unique opportunity to help top healthcare providers transform patient, workforce, consumer, and physician experiences at scale.
  • High-Performing, Collaborative Culture: We operate with a hands-on, customer-obsessed mindset—fostering transparency, trust, and accountability where frontline sales leaders and Enterprise Account Executives are coached to thrive.
  • Deep Cross-Functional Alignment: You won’t work in a silo; this team partners closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Solution Engineering to deliver a unified customer experience and ensure clients realize measurable value.
  • Commitment to Developing Future Leaders: Beyond hitting commercial numbers, our leadership culture prioritizes coaching, career development, and creating an environment where ambitious talent can do their best work.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • 100% Performance based promotions -- not politics or tenure
  • Culture - Incredible work environment - you can wear jeans and bring your dog to the office, anytime
  • Quarterly team activities, winter and summer parties, and lots of Qualtrics swag
The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote
